title: QueryFormer: Winning Solution for KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2609.16548v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-click conversion rate (pCVR) prediction requires jointly modeling feature interactions and sequential user behaviors. The KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge calls for a unified architecture addressing both. We observe that existing unified architectures often generate query tokens---the central information hub---with projection-based multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs), without explicit token-to-query attention for refining the query side. We propose QueryFormer, centered on a stackable unified field--sequence block that bridges non-sequential multi-field features and behavioral sequences, and provide a latency-aware scaling study over view width $H$, model width, depth, data, and compute. The block generates queries through cross-attention and packs sequence queries into shared-parameter attention. translated_title: QueryFormer：KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛冠军方案
translated_abstract: 点击后转化率（pCVR）预测需要联合建模特征交互与序列化用户行为。KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛要求提出一个同时解决这两个问题的统一架构。我们观察到，现有的统一架构通常使用基于投影的多层感知机（MLP）来生成查询 token——即核心信息枢纽——而缺乏显式的 token 到查询的注意力机制来精炼查询侧。我们提出 QueryFormer，其核心是一个可堆叠的统一字段-序列块，用于桥接非序列化的多字段特征与行为序列，并提供了针对视图宽度 $H$、模型宽度、深度、数据和计算的延迟感知缩放研究。该块通过交叉注意力生成查询，并将序列查询打包进共享参数注意力中。QueryFormer 在工业赛道斩获第一名，在官方测试集上取得了 0.83254 的 ROC 曲线下面积（AUC）成绩。
tldr: QueryFormer 提出可堆叠的统一字段-序列块，通过交叉注意力生成查询 token 并将序列查询打包进共享参数注意力，实现特征交互与序列用户行为的联合建模，夺得 KDD Cup 2026 腾讯 UniRec 挑战赛工业赛道第一名。
en_tdlr: QueryFormer introduces a stackable unified field–sequence block that generates query tokens via cross-attention and packs sequence queries into shared-parameter attention to jointly model feature interactions and sequential user behaviors, winning 1st place in the KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge Industrial Track.
